---
title: "Resampling & Randomization-Based Inference"
description: "Research on bootstrap, permutation and randomization-based inference."
---

I work on resampling-based methods for complex statistical designs, including bootstrap, permutation, and randomization procedures.

A current focus concerns inference for relative effects in repeated-measures and factorial settings with incomplete observations.
